help.short: OperationID which represents the export job.
The name of the recovery services vault.

description:
Get the operation result of operation triggered by Export Jobs API. If the operation is successful, then it also
contains URL of a Blob and a SAS key to access the same. The blob contains exported jobs in JSON serialized format.
